description: Build a premium, futuristic React frontend with dark navy/black background (#0a0e1a), electric blue (#3b82f6), cyan (#06b6d4) accents, glassmorphism cards, and Tailwind CSS. Implement React Router with sidebar navigation: Overview (dashboard), AI Agent Playground (chat), Security Gateway (flow visualization), Threat Detection (threat list), Activity Logs (event log), Security Policies (policy editor), Settings, Attack Simulation Lab. All metrics come from backend API, no hardcoded data. Use Recharts for visualizations: security events over time (line chart), threat categories (pie chart), allowed vs blocked actions (bar chart).
steps: Create frontend/ directory with standard Vite + React + TypeScript structure: src/ with components/, pages/, services/, types/, hooks/, App.tsx, main.tsx. Create index.html, vite.config.ts, tailwind.config.js, tsconfig.json, package.json

Create frontend/package.json with dependencies: react, react-dom, react-router-dom, axios, recharts, lucide-react, tailwindcss, @tailwindcss/forms, postcss, autoprefixer, typescript, vite, @vitejs/plugin-react
Create frontend/vite.config.ts with React plugin, dev server on 5173

Create frontend/tailwind.config.js with custom color palette: navy/black background (#0a0e1a), electric blue (#3b82f6), cyan (#06b6d4), grays for text, extend with glassmorphism backdrop-blur utilities

Create frontend/src/App.tsx with React Router setup: root layout with sidebar navigation, main content area, top nav bar with app name and user profile. Routes: /, /playground, /gateway, /threats, /logs, /policies, /settings, /lab
Create frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx with navigation links (7 main + settings), active state styling, collapse icon for mobile
Create frontend/src/components/TopNav.tsx with app name, gateway status indicator (green/orange/red based on recent events), demo user profile dropdown
Create frontend/src/components/Card.tsx with glassmorphic styling (backdrop-blur, semi-transparent bg-white/10, border-white/20), rounded corners, shadow
Create frontend/src/components/MetricCard.tsx showing title, value, change indicator (up/down), icon
Create frontend/src/components/Chart.tsx wrapper components: LineChart (security events over time), PieChart (threat categories), BarChart (allowed vs blocked). Use Recharts.

Create frontend/src/services/api.ts with axios instance: baseURL http://localhost:8000/api, error handling, token auth placeholder. Export functions: getEvents, getPolicies, getThreats, postMessage (agent), postGatewayEval, approveAction, etc.

Create frontend/src/pages/Overview.tsx: fetch events, policies, compute metrics (total requests, allowed, blocked, pending, injection attempts, exfiltration attempts), render 6 MetricCards, 3 Charts (events timeline, threat categories, allowed/blocked), recent incidents table with 5 latest events

Create frontend/src/pages/Playground.tsx: chat interface with message history, user input field, send button. Display: user message, agent response, proposed tool call (JSON), gateway decision (ALLOW/BLOCK/REQUIRE_APPROVAL with explanation), executed tool result. Fetch from /api/agent/message, stream or poll for response.

Create frontend/src/pages/SecurityGateway.tsx: show flow diagram (ASCII or SVG: Agent → Request → Gateway → Checks → Decision → Executor). Below, show table of 5 latest requests with per-check breakdown (Tool Auth, Resource Auth, Arg Validation, Injection Check, DLP Check, Destination Validation). Show pass/fail indicator and reason for each check.

Create frontend/src/pages/ThreatDetection.tsx: threat table with columns (Event ID, Timestamp, Category, Severity, Agent, Action, Reason, Response). Add filter row: by severity (Low/Medium/High/Critical), by category (Injection/Unauthorized Access/Exfiltration/Restricted File/Suspicious Behavior), by decision (BLOCK/ALLOW/REQUIRE_APPROVAL). Fetch from /api/threats, apply client-side filtering.

Create frontend/src/pages/ActivityLogs.tsx: full event log table with columns (ID, Timestamp, Agent, Tool, Status, Risk Score, Gateway Decision). Pagination or infinite scroll. Fetch from /api/events.

Create frontend/src/pages/SecurityPolicies.tsx: policy viewer/editor. List policies by role (employee, manager, admin). Show allowed tools per role. For each tool, show permission level (ALLOW/RESTRICTED/DENY). Include edit form (demo only, backend validates). Submit PUT to /api/policies/{id}.
Create frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: placeholder page with gateway configuration options (API key status, mock mode toggle, logging level, etc.). Not fully functional, for UI completeness.

Create frontend/src/pages/AttackSimulationLab.tsx: three buttons (Run Prompt Injection Scenario, Run Exfiltration Scenario, Run Unauthorized Tool Scenario). Each button calls POST /api/agent/mock?scenario=X, displays agent response and gateway decision side-by-side showing what was BLOCKED and why. Add description of each attack type.
Create frontend/public/ with favicon.ico, index.html manifest
Create frontend/src/types/index.ts with TypeScript interfaces: SecurityEvent, Threat, Policy, AgentResponse, GatewayDecision, User, etc.
Verify: npm run dev, open http://localhost:5173, navigate all pages, verify data loads from API, charts render, forms submit correctly
acceptance_criteria: Frontend starts on http://localhost:5173 with npm run dev
All 8 pages are accessible via sidebar navigation
Overview dashboard shows 6 metrics fetched from backend API
AI Playground accepts user input and displays agent response with gateway decision
Security Gateway page shows request flow and per-check breakdown
Threat Detection filters work (severity, category, decision)
Attack Simulation Lab runs all three scenarios and shows gateway blocking decisions
Design is professional with dark navy background, electric blue accents, glassmorphic cards
All pages are responsive and load data from backend
verification: npm run dev — frontend starts without error on 5173
npm run build — builds successfully to dist/
Navigate to Overview page — 6 metrics load from API with correct values
Navigate to Playground — send message, receive agent response with gateway decision
Navigate to SecurityGateway — shows recent requests with check breakdowns
Navigate to ThreatDetection — filter by severity, see threats filtered correctly
Navigate to AttackSimulationLab — click scenario button, see BLOCK decision displayed
Browser DevTools — no console errors, all API calls succeed (200/201)
